description.value: Olde School Coffee is a locally owned café in Cobble Hill, BC, operating out of a converted former preschool building. It serves freshly brewed coffee, real-fruit smoothies, breakfast wraps, sandwiches, and baked goods using local and organic ingredients where possible. Both a drive-thru window and a sit-down café space are available, making it a flexible stop for cyclists on the Cobble Hill road corridor.

address.value: 3515 Cobble Hill Road, Cobble Hill, BC V0R 1L5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Olde School Coffee is a real, operating coffee shop at 3515 Cobble Hill Road, Cobble Hill, BC. The homepage explicitly mentions 'Free wifi' as an amenity and a drive-thru service, confirming Wi-Fi and takeout. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms appears anywhere in the website content. The OSM community field lists 'Duncan' but the business is clearly in Cobble Hill per both OSM address tags and the website.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Duncan' but the business address is Cobble Hill, BC — these are different communities roughly 15 km apart.

Two different email addresses appear on the website: 'info@oldeschoolcoffee.com' in the main content area and 'oldeschoolcoffeeshop@gmail.com' in the footer, suggesting the site has not been fully updated.
Hours shown in the main content section of the website differ from those displayed in the footer, indicating at least one set is likely outdated.
